scenarios.name: real_extension_windowless_owned_startup
scenarios.title: Create the extension-owned window before the first CDP page
scenarios.workflow: Actual Chrome with no startup window -> real extension hello must already name its owned target -> CDP first page creation proceeds once -> connect and inspect matching runtime -> neutral form on extension-owned target -> trusted typing and exactly one submission
scenarios.user_problem: A connected extension must create its own usable page when Chrome initially has no window.
